title: Genres with many albums
statementMd:
Which genres have at least 7 albums?

Expected columns: `genre`, `albums`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS albums FROM albums GROUP BY genre HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
